docs.title: Welcome to HarveyWiki!
docs.text:
Welcome!

This is HarveyWiki, a Wiki created by the self-proclaimed polymathician Harvey Widjaja.

Here you can find things he finds interesting, and about his self-made companies and friends.

docs.title: CodaCode Studios
docs.text: CodaCode Game Development Studios is a Video Game company founded by Harvey Widjaja in early 2026. He then invited is friends to join, making it a classic indie dev team.

docs.title: General Information
docs.text: Company Type Video Game Development Subsidiaries CodaCode Music, CodaCode Contracting Protection Status Common-Law Trademark, General Copyright Specialties Video Game Development, Music Composition Published Games N/A (None right now)

docs.title: Early Beginnings
docs.text: CodaCode Studios was created sometime in early 2026, of course, by Harvey. At first, it was just a placeholder for his "games" that he had developed at the time. It soon then evolved into the indie dev team it is today, with his 7 friends on the team.

docs.title: The Slay McBaddiez Group
docs.text: The Slay McBaddiez Group (or legally called "Slay McBaddies") is a small friend group based in Metro Vancouver, British Columbia.
